Repository: hmap
What the code contains: `hmap` is a Python project with 310 module(s), 84 HTTP endpoint(s), a command line (`backend/src/hmap/agents/docgen/compile_report.py`, `backend/src/hmap/core/runtime/host.py`, `infra/observability/load/soak.py`) and 111 test file(s). Its main parts are `backend/alembic/`, `hmap`, `hmap.agents`, `hmap.api`, `hmap.core`, `hmap.db`, `hmap.manager`, `hmap.obs`.
Summary of the code: The hmap repository implements a hierarchical multi‑agent AI execution platform that coordinates agents, tasks, and observability across a single‑process composition root (backend/src/hmap/system.py::system). Core platform services live in hmap.core (e.g., backend/src/hmap/core/config.py::config and backend/src/hmap/core/runtime/base.py::base) and provide settings, error handling, tracing, and the agent plug‑in contract. Agents such as the documentation generator (backend/src/hmap/agents/docgen/model.py::model) and the testing sandbox (backend/src/hmap/agents/testing/sandbox/__init__.py::sandbox) use these contracts, while the manager (hmap.manager) runs the task state machine and graph executor. Persistence is handled by hmap.db (Postgres connection pool and migrations), and observability is provided by hmap.obs (traces and metrics). Supporting tooling in hmaptools (e.g., hmaptools.report::report) enables regression checks, ownership validation, and secret scanning across the 310 modules and 84 HTTP endpoints.
